about.metadataDescription: Asynchrone Space is the AI-native productivity platform built by a distributed team.
about.title: Building the workspace teams deserve
about.description: Asynchrone Space started with a simple belief: the tools teams use every day should feel like one product. We're a distributed team of builders, designers and researchers working to make that real.
about.valueClarityDescription: We build tools that make the state of the work obvious, so teams spend less time asking and more time doing.
about.valueAiDescription: Assistants should handle the busywork — summaries, updates and follow-ups — so people can focus on judgement.
about.valueWorkspaceDescription: Context shouldn't live in five tabs. Projects, chat, calendar and files belong together.

faq.metadataDescription: Answers about plans, security, the AI assistants and migrating your team.
faq.title: Questions, answered
faq.description: Everything you need to know before getting started. Can't find what you're looking for?
faq.sectionDescription: Everything you need to know before getting started.
faq.q1: How does the free plan work?
faq.a1: The Starter plan is free forever and includes projects, tasks, messaging and 1 GB of storage. No credit card required.
faq.q2: How do the AI assistants fit in?
faq.a2: Assistants live inside your workspace. They can summarize threads, draft task updates and answer questions about your projects, files and calendar.
faq.a3: Yes. Data is encrypted in transit and at rest, and organizations include role-based access control. SSO, SCIM and a customer-facing audit log are coming to Enterprise.
faq.q4: Can I import from other tools?
faq.a4: You can bring your team over quickly — invite members by email and import your client companies and contacts from a CSV file.
